versions.changelog:
atomic-knowledge-explainer 1.0.0

- Initial release of an atomic concept knowledge explainer.
- Splits complex knowledge into atomic concepts with full explanations.
- Defaults to showing concept association structures; full explanations available on request.
- Structured into 6 domains and 30 task types, covering end-to-end knowledge decomposition and delivery.
- Includes clear execution steps, downgrade mode, and factual discipline guidance.
